title: A solution to the Erd\H{o}s Problem #1040
abstract: arXiv:2609.06050v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For a compact set $K\subset\mathbb{C}$, let $\vartheta(K)$ be the infimum of the planar areas of the unit lemniscates of all monic polynomials with zeros in $K$, allowing arbitrary degree and repeated zeros. We prove that $\vartheta(K)=0$ whenever $\operatorname{cap}(K)=1$, with no regularity assumption on $K$. The proof uses a centered harmonic polynomial that is positive on all but a set of arbitrarily small area in the polynomial hull of $K$. A Fourier average of exterior harmonic measures realizes this polynomial as the logarithmic potential of a signed measure having bounded density with respect to the equilibrium measure. A positive perturbation and an $L^1$ approximation by empirical measures then produce the required polynomials. This extends the smooth-boundary result of Krishnapur, Lundberg, and Ramachandran to arbitrary compact sets of capacity one. Together with the capacity-greater-than-one theorem of Ghosh and Ramachandra

translated_title: 埃尔德什问题 #1040 的一个解
translated_abstract: 对于紧集 $K\subset\mathbb{C}$，令 $\vartheta(K)$ 为所有零点位于 $K$ 中的首一多项式（允许任意次数和重根）的单位双纽线的平面面积的下确界。我们证明，只要 $\operatorname{cap}(K)=1$，就有 $\vartheta(K)=0$，且对 $K$ 无需任何正则性假设。证明使用了一个中心化调和多项式，该多项式在 $K$ 的多项式凸包内除一个面积可任意小的集合外处处为正。通过外部调和测度的傅里叶平均，该多项式被实现为一个符号测度的对数位势，该符号测度相对于平衡测度具有有界密度。随后通过正扰动以及经验测度的 $L^1$ 逼近，构造出所需的多项式。这将 Krishnapur、Lundberg 和 Ramachandran 关于光滑边界的结果推广到了容量为一的任意紧集。结合 Ghosh 和 Ramachandran 关于容量大于一的定理……
tldr: 本文证明了对容量恰好为1的任意紧集（无需正则性假设），单位双纽线的最小平面面积为零，从而解决了埃尔德什问题 #1040，并将已知的光滑边界结果推广到任意容量为一的紧集。
